profile.input_contract: JSON wave speed, mesh/time step, and initial pulse parameters.
profile.output_contract: JSON wave metrics including peak amplitude and energy proxy.
profile.adapter: Python finite-difference runner and JSON parser/adapter under SUT/wave_1d/.

mrs.description: Linearity MP_mono: the 1D linear wave equation u_tt = c²·u_xx is linear in the initial condition. Scaling the initial Gaussian amplitude by factor > 1 must strictly increase the final peak amplitude (and in fact scale it by the same factor exactly under the linear leapfrog discretisation).

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Mono MR: Linearity MP_mono: the 1D linear wave equation u_tt = c²·u_xx is linear in the initial condition.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleField via transform steps [ScaleField@/initial/amplitude] to derive follow-up input while preserving unrelated fields.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `peak_amplitude` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `wave-amplitude-linearity`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `greater` / `GreaterThan` checks the expected relation on `peak_amplitude`.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Ordinal predicate: no numeric tolerance is applied beyond the declared ordering relation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable when SUT `wave-1d` exposes sample `sample/standard.json`, the transform target fields, and output `peak_amplitude`; otherwise not applicable.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the SUT output, adapter mapping, or predicate evidence disagrees with the declared metamorphic expectation.

mrs.description: Mesh-refinement convergence MP_conv: the second-order leapfrog scheme converges as O(dx², dt²). Doubling num_points (with internal dt halving to keep Courant = 0.5) must leave the integrated energy proxy 0.5·∫u² dx within FD truncation tolerance — for a smooth Gaussian initial pulse the L² invariant is preserved to near machine precision under refinement.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Conv MR: Mesh-refinement convergence MP_conv: the second-order leapfrog scheme converges as O(dx², dt²).
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleField via transform steps [ScaleField@/geometry/num_points] to derive follow-up input while preserving unrelated fields.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `energy_proxy` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `wave-mesh-energy-convergence`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `approx` / `ApproxEqual` checks the expected relation on `energy_proxy`.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Deterministic tolerance rel=0.001, abs=1e-06 bounds acceptable numeric deviation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable when SUT `wave-1d` exposes sample `sample/standard.json`, the transform target fields, and output `energy_proxy`; otherwise not applicable.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the SUT output, adapter mapping, or predicate evidence disagrees with the declared metamorphic expectation.
